company.shortDescription: ShopWith is an online shopping platform that provides fashion shopping services.
company.description: ShopWith is an online shopping platform that provides fashion shopping services. The platform features a wide range of recommended fashion, beauty products, and shop items from influencing brands and creators, enabling shoppers to browse virtual storefronts and aisles alongside their favorite fashion creators and YouTubers. Melody Kim, Aaron Chou, and Lewis Chung founded it in October 2017, with its headquarters in San Francisco in California.
